node.statement: Preliminary uniform modulus. The datum gives ||gamma_jk,n(X_jk)|| between (1-rho)||X_jk|| and (1+rho)||X_jk||. Hence the triangle inequality and node 1.1.1 give ||gamma_n(X)||<=4(1+rho)||X||. Choose a block X_jk with ||X_jk||>=||X||/4. Applying C_jk,n to gamma_n(X), node 1.1.2 isolates gamma_jk,n(X_jk) up to K e||X||, while ||C_jk,n|| is universally bounded. Thus, after one universal smallness restriction, c_0||X||<=||gamma_n(X)||<=5||X|| for a universal c_0>0, for every n.
